islet transplantation can improve quality of life and reduce hypoglycemics in selected patients with type 2 diabetes; islet transplantation should not be performed for insulin independence, as this is not achievable; and islet transplantation can prolong life span of islets and reduce islet loss.

the development of new therapeutic options for patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and the prevention of complications.
the treatment of type 1 diabetic patients with severely unstable diabetes and hypoglycemiainduced complications.
the development of new therapeutic approaches for type 1 diabetic patients with unstable metabolic control.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
islet transplantation is an excellent treatment for patients suffering from unstable diabetes with repeated hypoglycemias.
islet transplantation is a safe and feasible procedure with long-term results for selected patients.
islet transplantation is an effective and safe treatment option in selected patients.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
islet transplantation can improve quality of life in selected type 1 diabetic patients with severely unstable diabetes.
islet transplantation is an effective treatment option for selected patients with type 2 diabetes and unstable metabolic control.
islet transplantation is a safe procedure for patients with unstable type 1 diabetes and repeated hypoglucemic episodes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
islet transplantation should not be considered a treatment option for all patients with type 2 diabetes.
islet transplantation can provide a life-saving therapy to selected patients with unstable type 1 diabetes.
islet transplantation should remain an investigational therapy for patients with type 2 diabetes.
